summary: Frontend-only navigation refactor validation for IronFlow. ALL FLOWS PASS. Verified the new 5-tab layout (tab-today, tab-training, tab-add, tab-progression, tab-profile) at mobile viewport (390x844). The central + FAB opens the 'Ajouter rapidement' modal (does NOT navigate to /add) and all 6 quick-action tiles (qa-session/measure/photo/habit/journal/pr) are present and route correctly after modal dismiss. AUJOURD'HUI dashboard shows IRONFLOW header, greeting 'Bonsoir', date 'Dimanche 26 Juillet', SCORE DU JOUR circle, DÉMARRER LA SÉANCE (start-session -> /plans), 'À faire aujourd'hui' checklist with Séance row, and Poids/Streak/Volume stats. Entraînements hub has all 4 segments (seg-program/sessions/plans/mobility) and empty-state CTAs (browse-programs, create-plan, browse-stretch) all render. Progression hub has all 5 segments (prog-seg-overview/exercises/transformation/habits/journal), the SCORE IRONFLOW /100 circle with 6 breakdown rows (Régularité/Progression/Habitudes/Diversité/Records/Activité récente), and open-full-stats navigates to /stats. Profile tab renders the profile screen with all 4 shortcuts (open-achievements/goals/stats/history). Habit editor at /habit/new exposes habit-kind-water, habit-title, habit-target, habit-unit, habit-in-score, save-habit. Daily journal at /daily-journal exposes save-daily-journal and Énergie/Motivation/Humeur/Stress ratings + sleep/pain/notes fields. Two non-blocking react-native-web deprecation warnings remain (pointerEvents prop, shadow* style props).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Likely from the FAB style in (tabs)/_layout.tsx which uses shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius. Migrate to boxShadow for web parity (or wrap with Platform.select). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:236-239.
Console warning still present: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Same as previous iteration. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx (hero overlay).

action_items: Optional cleanup: migrate FAB shadow* props to boxShadow (or Platform.select) in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx to silence react-native-web deprecation.
Optional cleanup: replace pointerEvents='none' prop with style.pointerEvents in app/(tabs)/index.tsx hero overlay/spacer.
critical_code_review_comments: Central + tab correctly uses listeners.tabPress with e.preventDefault() + setAddOpen(true) — the modal presentation pattern is correct and matches the requirement (no navigation to /add).
Hidden tab routes (program/plans/stretching/progress/history) correctly use href:null to preserve deep-link routing while removing them from the tab bar.
profile-tab.tsx cleanly re-exports the profile screen — good DRY.
training.tsx and progression.tsx use useFocusEffect(useCallback...) to refresh data on tab focus — correct pattern.
seed_data_creation: None — empty-state paths were sufficient to validate the refactor.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The navigation refactor is fully verified. All required testIDs exist and route correctly. Only cosmetic RN-Web deprecation warnings remain (pointerEvents prop, shadow* style props). No functional regressions.
